name: Phoenix Contact MKDS 1,5/ 2-5,08 2-position 5.08 mm PCB terminal block (1715721)
//: Phoenix Contact's 2-position 5.08 mm screw terminal, item 1715721, from its catalogue data sheet - a 5-page PDF generated from the online catalogue, dated 09/03/2016, read via Octopart's copy because phoenixcontact.com answers 403 to a fetcher. Nominal current 17.5 A, maximum load current 22 A, rated voltage 400 V (III/2), nominal 1.5 mm², 0.14-2.5 mm² solid / 0.14-1.5 mm² flexible, AWG 26-14, 12.7 x 9.8 mm and 17.3 mm tall, 3.5 mm pins 0.9 x 0.9 mm in 1.3 mm holes, M3 screw at 0.5-0.6 Nm, 7 mm strip length, PA UL94 V-0, Sn pins, made in Germany, 2.74 g. Read 2026-09-29 for the 'or a 2-way screw terminal' half of the irrigation controller's inlet need. Rails are named as that design names them.
//why_not: Carries the load eight times over; not chosen because the inlet was decided as a barrel jack for a wall adapter, and at 25 Kč it is five times the Kangnex block for the same job.
//sources: Octopart's copy of Phoenix's catalogue sheet is the one document read. Phoenix's own page (https://www.phoenixcontact.com/en-pc/products/pcb-terminal-block-mkds-15-2-508-1715721) answered 403 and is not cited; the TME listing is under sourcing because TME answers 403 to a bare HEAD.

power.note: Position 1. No polarity in the part; the silkscreen decides.
Position 2. The supply's return; the star point belongs here.

//pin_order: Two identical positions; pad 1 = VIN is this record's convention, not the part's. Mark it on the silkscreen.
footprint_note: pinrow2 is a 2.54 mm pitch; the catalogue sheet says pitch 5.08 mm, hole diameter 1.3 mm, pin 0.9 x 0.9 mm, solder pin length 3.5 mm. footprinter's pitch parameter (pinrow2_p5.08mm) was not tried here.

body_mm.note: Catalogue table: Width 12.7 mm (across the two positions including the end walls), Length 9.8 mm (depth, the wire axis), Height 17.3 mm, constructional height 13.8 mm. width = across the positions, height = depth.

host_requirements: No polarity: print + and - on the silkscreen at the block.
Stranded wire under a screw needs a ferrule; the sheet allows 0.25-1.5 mm² with ferrules.
Side entry (conductor/PCB connection direction 0°): leave clearance beyond the board edge for the wires and above for a screwdriver.
Fuse after it; 17.5 A of contact will not protect a 2 A rail.

nominal_current_a.note: 'Nominal current IN 17.5 A'; TME's listing states the same.
nominal_current_a.why_it_matters: Eight times the irrigation board's load; the block is not the limit.

rated_voltage_iii2_v.note: 'Rated voltage (III/2) 400 V'; (III/3) 250 V; (II/2) 630 V; rated surge voltage 4 kV.

ul_nominal_current_a.note: UL Recognized, use group B: 15 A at 300 V, 30-14 AWG; group D 10 A. CSA 10 A at 300 V.

conductor_flexible_mm2_max.note: With ferrules, with or without plastic sleeve: 0.25-1.5 mm².

positions.note: 'The article can be aligned to create different nos. of positions' - blocks latch side by side.

height_mm.note: 'Height 17.3 mm', 'Constructional height 13.8 mm'; TME states 17,3mm too.
